message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red vertical stripe on the left edge. The word “TEMPO” is printed in large, black, serif capital letters at the top. Below this is the date "16-22 FEBRUARI 2015".

The central figure is a man with a mustache and short dark hair, wearing a tan multi-pocketed vest over a grey shirt and blue pants. He is seated on the floor in front of a tall, dark blue shelving unit filled with blue binders. His right hand is clenched in a fist, and his left hand rests on his thigh. A large, dark shadow of a person looms behind him on the shelves. 

The text "TEROR UNTUK KPK" is centered in large, white, bold capital letters over the man’s legs. Smaller white text below reads: "Seorang jenderal polisi memaksa penyidik KPK memberi kesaksian meringankan buat Budi Gunawan. Disertai ancaman pembunuhan."

Several blue binders are scattered on the floor around the man's feet. One binder in the foreground is labeled “BLBI”. In the bottom right corner, a barcode, the price “RP 39.500”, and a website address are visible. Additional headlines are printed across the top margin.
